title: Unbounded proper/open support for squares with distinct open sources
statement: Let k:X→T1 and i:Y→T2 be quasi-compact open immersions, p:T1→T2 and r:X→Y proper, with kp=ri. For every finite commutative ring A and arbitrary K in the ordinary unbounded pro-etale derived category on X, the canonical open counit i!i* Rp* k!K→Rp* k!K is invertible. The two opens may have distinct sources, unlike the triangle case [lem-sp-proper-open-derived-support].

source.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7K; agent expansion of the blueprint composition/refinement calculation

proof.text: Lift X into the Cartesian pullback T1×T2Y. Open cancellation gives an open immersion. Open composition and the Cartesian proper/open sheaf comparison express p* k!M as extension from Y. Full faithfulness makes its canonical open counit invertible.

Use the proper/open injective acyclicity theorem on an injective resolution of a bounded-below input. The termwise supported counit is an isomorphism; the acyclic resolution comparison descends this assertion to the derived functors.

The lower Postnikov tower reconstructs every complex since countable products are exact. Open extension and restriction preserve those products; derived proper direct image is a right adjoint and preserves them. The supported subcategory is stable under the resulting homotopy limit. Apply bounded support at every truncation, and transport by the derived representative isomorphism.
